# Lore Bard Build Ranking Results

*Generated by executing `runLoreBardExploration(25, 0)` — the full 1,976-build matrix,
25 simulation iterations per scenario. Results are deterministic once the random seed
stabilises across iterations; run the matrix again to confirm.*

> **How to reproduce:** Call `POST /api/bard/instantiate` with any `buildId` from
> `GET /api/bard/explore` and include `"runFullRanking": true` in the request body.
> The API will run the full matrix and return the build's `benchmarkRank` and `rankedAmong`.

---

## Methodology

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Total builds evaluated | **1,976** |
| Simulation iterations per scenario | **25** |
| Scenarios | 10 (4 combat, 3 social, 3 party-support) |
| Scoring weights | Combat 40% · Social 40% · Party Support 20% |
| Matrix execution time | **~1.4 s** |

The `compositeScore` is an integer on a 0–100 scale representing the weighted average
of all ten scenario scores. Builds are ranked from highest to lowest composite score.
Ties are broken by internal order (first generated wins).

The Firbolg occupies the bottom tier consistently due to its Hidden Step mechanic
offering only defensive repositioning — it does not compensate for the social penalty
imposed by the species' lower CHA modifier relative to the build's scoring model.

## PR #25 Example Build

The build referenced in the PR #25 description:
**`lore-half-elf-standard__actor+war-caster__cloak-of-pro+hat-of-disgu`**

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Rank | **173** of 1,976 |
| Composite Score | 56 |
| AC | 14 |
| Max HP | 52 |
| CHA modifier | +4 |
| Spell Save DC | 15 |

### Scenario Breakdown

| Scenario | Score | Category |
|----------|------:|----------|
| Bandit Ambush | 82 | Combat |
| Gnoll War Band | 13 | Combat |
| Undead Horde | 0 | Combat |
| Warlock's Hold | 6 | Combat |
| Convince the City Guard | 96 | Social |
| Infiltrate the Noble Gala | 92 | Social |
| Inspire the Downtrodden | 96 | Social |
| The Dragon Ambush | 61 | Party Support |
| The Road to Baldur's Gate | 40 | Party Support |
| The Lord's Alliance Summit | 23 | Party Support |

**Strengths noted by simulation:**
- Exceptional social aptitude
- High Charisma (+4 modifier)
- Concentration spell reliability (War Caster)
- Deception mastery (Actor feat)
- Cutting Words + expanded spell selection (Magical Secrets)
- Expertise in: Persuasion, Deception
- Fey Ancestry: immune to charm/sleep effects

**Weaknesses noted by simulation:**
- Below-average combat durability
- Moderate AC — vulnerable to sustained attacks
- Below-average HP pool
- Low Strength — physical challenges are difficult
- Lower martial contribution than Valor subclass

**Simulation assessment:** *"A viable candidate. Some paths remain suboptimal — examine the breakdown to locate the weakness."*
